### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

# Where enterprise AI runs and outcomes scale.

## The trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference
## and agents in production.

From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to
deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that
regulated and mission-critical environments demand.

[ Talk to an Expert ][117] [ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][118]

## Introducing our AI operating framework

Palantir has named Rackspace a preferred partner to deploy and operate Foundry and AIP for
regulated, sovereign and private cloud environments.

[ Read the Press Release ][119] [ Explore the Partnership ][120]
[Rackspace Palantir]
[Enterprise AI Cloud]

## Rackspace is the operator of the full enterprise AI stack.

### One partner. Full accountability.

We assemble, integrate and operate the full stack from governed private cloud to AI inference and
agents in production, and remain accountable for outcomes long after deployment is complete.

#### Curated partners across every layer of the stack.

We have assembled best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack to connect models, platform
and infrastructure into a governed system, purpose-built for enterprise AI in regulated
environments.

#### Governance built in. Not bolted on.

Security, compliance, data sovereignty and uptime are foundational to every enterprise AI cloud we
operate, especially in regulated and high-stakes environments.

#### Forward deployed engineers who build, run and scale

Our engineers embed directly in your environment to build, operationalize and run enterprise AI,
turning use cases into production systems and scaling them over time.

[ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][121]

## Enterprise AI Cloud Partner Ecosystem

We have curated best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack. Our ecosystem is deliberate,
opinionated and selected for how partners integrate across the stack and how they perform within it.
Everything is stitched together and governed as one system, so you can focus on outcomes instead of
managing complexity.

[AMD][VMware by Broadcom][Palantir][UNIPHORE][Rubrik][Dell Technologies]
[Explore our Ecosystem][122]
[Seattle Children's Logo]

> “We partnered with Rackspace because of Fanatical Experience® and their ability to provide an
> infrastructure to a guaranteed uptime of 99.999%, which means that our clinicians would have
> secure access to our EMR around the clock at the point of care.”

Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer,
Seattle Children’s Hospital [ See the case study ][123]

[See more case studies][124]

## 25+ years of experience operating mission-critical infrastructure. We’re built to run what comes
## next.

From infrastructure to enterprise AI in production, our depth shows up in the certification our
engineers hold, the platforms we’re qualified to operated and the environments we’ve kept running
for the industries that trust us with their most critical systems.

2,200+ certified technical experts
10,000+ technical certifications
600+ AI platform certifications
39 data centers globally

## Industry-Recognized Leadership

Independently recognized by the leading analysts who cover enterprise infrastructure and AI.

[Forrester][Gartner][IDC][ISG]

## Ready to operationalize AI?

Let's explore your use cases and build the full-stack foundation for real outcomes.

[ Get Started ][125]

# Where enterprise AI runs and outcomes scale.

## The trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference
## and agents in production.

From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to
deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that
regulated and mission-critical environments demand.

[ Talk to an Expert ][117] [ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][118]

## Introducing our AI operating framework

Palantir has named Rackspace a preferred partner to deploy and operate Foundry and AIP for
regulated, sovereign and private cloud environments.

[ Read the Press Release ][119] [ Explore the Partnership ][120]
[Rackspace Palantir]
[Enterprise AI Cloud]

## Rackspace is the operator of the full enterprise AI stack.

### One partner. Full accountability.

We assemble, integrate and operate the full stack from governed private cloud to AI inference and
agents in production, and remain accountable for outcomes long after deployment is complete.

#### Curated partners across every layer of the stack.

We have assembled best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack to connect models, platform
and infrastructure into a governed system, purpose-built for enterprise AI in regulated
environments.

#### Governance built in. Not bolted on.

Security, compliance, data sovereignty and uptime are foundational to every enterprise AI cloud we
operate, especially in regulated and high-stakes environments.

#### Forward deployed engineers who build, run and scale

Our engineers embed directly in your environment to build, operationalize and run enterprise AI,
turning use cases into production systems and scaling them over time.

[ Explore Enterprise AI Cloud ][121]

## Enterprise AI Cloud Partner Ecosystem

We have curated best-of-breed partners across every layer of the stack. Our ecosystem is deliberate,
opinionated and selected for how partners integrate across the stack and how they perform within it.
Everything is stitched together and governed as one system, so you can focus on outcomes instead of
managing complexity.

[AMD][VMware by Broadcom][Palantir][UNIPHORE][Rubrik][Dell Technologies]
[Explore our Ecosystem][122]
[Seattle Children's Logo]

> “We partnered with Rackspace because of Fanatical Experience® and their ability to provide an
> infrastructure to a guaranteed uptime of 99.999%, which means that our clinicians would have
> secure access to our EMR around the clock at the point of care.”

Dr. Zafar Chaudry, MD, Senior VP, Chief Digital Officer and Chief AI and Information Officer,
Seattle Children’s Hospital [ See the case study ][123]

[See more case studies][124]

## 25+ years of experience operating mission-critical infrastructure. We’re built to run what comes
## next.

From infrastructure to enterprise AI in production, our depth shows up in the certification our
engineers hold, the platforms we’re qualified to operated and the environments we’ve kept running
for the industries that trust us with their most critical systems.

2,200+ certified technical experts
10,000+ technical certifications
600+ AI platform certifications
39 data centers globally

## Industry-Recognized Leadership

Independently recognized by the leading analysts who cover enterprise infrastructure and AI.

[Forrester][Gartner][IDC][ISG]

## Ready to operationalize AI?

Let's explore your use cases and build the full-stack foundation for real outcomes.

[ Get Started ][125]

Strategic perspectives on the infrastructure and governance decisions that separate successful AI
deployments from stalled experiments

## FAQs

**Less complexity. More clarity. Start here.**
Answers to common questions about our IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and more.
[Contact Arctiq][112] today with any questions. Our team is here to help. 

What IT services does Arctiq provide?

Arctiq provides comprehensive IT services, including [cybersecurity services][113], [hybrid cloud
solutions,][114] [networking and connected experiences][115], [data and AI platforms][116],
[autonomous operations and intelligence][117], [enterprise service management][118], and [managed IT
services][119]. We help organizations modernize, secure, and optimize their technology environments
across the full lifecycle. 

What is the fastest way to improve ransomware resilience?

Start with immutable backups, implement EDR, centralize telemetry in a SIEM, and rehearse recovery.
Arctiq’s ServiceIQ approach sequences these steps to reduce risk quickly. Learn more on our
[Ransomware Readiness](/services/ransomware-strategies) page.

Does Arctiq offer managed security services and 24/7 SOC support?

Yes. Arctiq delivers [managed security services ][120]with 24/7 monitoring through our Security
Operations Centers (SOCs). Our capabilities include managed detection and response (MDR/MXDR), SIEM,
threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and incident response. 

How does MXDR differ from traditional SOC monitoring?

MXDR unifies endpoint, network, identity, and cloud signals with automated response. Our managed
service adds playbooks, 24/7 monitoring, and threat hunting. See [Managed Security
Services](/services/managed-security-services).

How can Arctiq help with cloud migration and hybrid cloud solutions?

Arctiq helps organizations plan and execute cloud migration strategies while building scalable
[hybrid cloud environments][121]. We support workload migration, cloud optimization, and
infrastructure modernization to improve performance, flexibility, and cost efficiency. 

How does Arctiq support data, analytics, and AI initiatives?

Arctiq helps organizations build [modern data platforms][122], enable analytics, and deploy AI
solutions that drive business value. From data engineering and governance to machine learning and
automation, we help turn data into actionable insights.

How do I get started with Arctiq IT services?

Getting started is simple and we meet you where you are in the process. Arctiq's expert
consultants often begins with an IT assessment or consultation to understand your current
environment and goals. From there, we develop a tailored roadmap to help you modernize, secure, and
scale your technology. [Connect with us][123] today no matter where you are in your journey.

Our experts are prepared to help you navigate complex technological challenges and drive meaningful
business outcomes.

## FAQs

**Less complexity. More clarity. Start here.**
Answers to common questions about our IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and more.
[Contact Arctiq][112] today with any questions. Our team is here to help. 

What IT services does Arctiq provide?

Arctiq provides comprehensive IT services, including [cybersecurity services][113], [hybrid cloud
solutions,][114] [networking and connected experiences][115], [data and AI platforms][116],
[autonomous operations and intelligence][117], [enterprise service management][118], and [managed IT
services][119]. We help organizations modernize, secure, and optimize their technology environments
across the full lifecycle. 

What is the fastest way to improve ransomware resilience?

Start with immutable backups, implement EDR, centralize telemetry in a SIEM, and rehearse recovery.
Arctiq’s ServiceIQ approach sequences these steps to reduce risk quickly. Learn more on our
[Ransomware Readiness](/services/ransomware-strategies) page.

Does Arctiq offer managed security services and 24/7 SOC support?

Yes. Arctiq delivers [managed security services ][120]with 24/7 monitoring through our Security
Operations Centers (SOCs). Our capabilities include managed detection and response (MDR/MXDR), SIEM,
threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and incident response. 

How does MXDR differ from traditional SOC monitoring?

MXDR unifies endpoint, network, identity, and cloud signals with automated response. Our managed
service adds playbooks, 24/7 monitoring, and threat hunting. See [Managed Security
Services](/services/managed-security-services).

How can Arctiq help with cloud migration and hybrid cloud solutions?

Arctiq helps organizations plan and execute cloud migration strategies while building scalable
[hybrid cloud environments][121]. We support workload migration, cloud optimization, and
infrastructure modernization to improve performance, flexibility, and cost efficiency. 

How does Arctiq support data, analytics, and AI initiatives?

Arctiq helps organizations build [modern data platforms][122], enable analytics, and deploy AI
solutions that drive business value. From data engineering and governance to machine learning and
automation, we help turn data into actionable insights.

How do I get started with Arctiq IT services?

Getting started is simple and we meet you where you are in the process. Arctiq's expert
consultants often begins with an IT assessment or consultation to understand your current
environment and goals. From there, we develop a tailored roadmap to help you modernize, secure, and
scale your technology. [Connect with us][123] today no matter where you are in your journey.

Our experts are prepared to help you navigate complex technological challenges and drive meaningful
business outcomes.

### open-source based on Apache 2.0 and 100% tinker friendly. You can install CasaOS on ZimaBoard,
### Intel NUC, and Raspberry Pi.

### Hardware

CasaOS fully supports [ZimaBoard][9], Intel NUC, and Raspberry Pi. Also, more computers and
development boards with the following architectures: amd64, armv7, arm64.

### System

CasaOS is fully compatible with Ubuntu, Debian, Raspberry Pi OS, and CentOS with one-liner
installation. Not sure about your compatibility? Check out the [ Discord][10]

Rick Stevens

Scott Wu
CEO, Cognition

best at. The result is inference that's an order of magnitude faster and higher performance than

David Brown

## FAQs

How do you improve AI cost efficiency?

Allocation, attribution, then optimization. The most effective levers are understanding where AI
spend is going, mapping it to the outcomes that drive the business, and optimizing their spend spend
based on what they learn. The CloudZero financial control plane provides full visibility on AI ROI.

What platforms can CloudZero connect to?

CloudZero can ingest and unify data from any AI, IaaS, PaaS, or SaaS provider. That includes
Anthropic, Open AI, Gemini, the big three, but also AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Snowflake, Datadog,
MongoDB, and whatever else you’re using. We then convert the spend information into a common data
model and present it in a single pane of glass.

Can CloudZero show me a metric like cost per customer?

Yes. Our platform can calculate whatever unit cost metric is most important to you — including cost
per customer, per feature, per team, per transaction … the possibilities are endless.

Who is CloudZero for?

CloudZero is built for the teams that own the AI and cloud spend conversation. 

**Finance leaders (CFOs, FP&A, controllers) **tie every dollar of AI and cloud spend to the outcomes
they report on, such as customer, product, transaction, and P&L, so they can forecast it and defend
it to the board.

**Engineering leaders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering)** see what every model call, agent, and workload
costs in AI Hub and in their coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), so they can pull
cost context where they already work, not chase it down after the bill arrives.

**Platform and cloud ops teams **author the allocation structure in CostFormation, so finance and
engineering see the same numbers, without months of tagging cleanup.

How long does it take to get started with CloudZero?

You can connect to the CloudZero platform in minutes and start seeing value right away. While some
special projects may require you to provide us with data, generally getting started requires very
little effort. From there, it only takes a few hours to uncover additional metrics like unit cost,
cost per customer, etc. Go [here][56] to review our entire setup process and the time commitment you
can expect at each step.

How much does CloudZero cost?

CloudZero uses a tiered pricing model that’s steady, predictable, and won’t vary month to month.
Unlike other cloud cost products, we don’t charge monthly overages — so, if your spend spikes one
month, your price stays the same.

## FAQs

How do you improve AI cost efficiency?

Allocation, attribution, then optimization. The most effective levers are understanding where AI
spend is going, mapping it to the outcomes that drive the business, and optimizing their spend spend
based on what they learn. The CloudZero financial control plane provides full visibility on AI ROI.

What platforms can CloudZero connect to?

CloudZero can ingest and unify data from any AI, IaaS, PaaS, or SaaS provider. That includes
Anthropic, Open AI, Gemini, the big three, but also AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, Snowflake, Datadog,
MongoDB, and whatever else you’re using. We then convert the spend information into a common data
model and present it in a single pane of glass.

Can CloudZero show me a metric like cost per customer?

Yes. Our platform can calculate whatever unit cost metric is most important to you — including cost
per customer, per feature, per team, per transaction … the possibilities are endless.

Who is CloudZero for?

CloudZero is built for the teams that own the AI and cloud spend conversation. 

**Finance leaders (CFOs, FP&A, controllers) **tie every dollar of AI and cloud spend to the outcomes
they report on, such as customer, product, transaction, and P&L, so they can forecast it and defend
it to the board.

**Engineering leaders (CTOs, VPs of Engineering)** see what every model call, agent, and workload
costs in AI Hub and in their coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), so they can pull
cost context where they already work, not chase it down after the bill arrives.

**Platform and cloud ops teams **author the allocation structure in CostFormation, so finance and
engineering see the same numbers, without months of tagging cleanup.

How long does it take to get started with CloudZero?

You can connect to the CloudZero platform in minutes and start seeing value right away. While some
special projects may require you to provide us with data, generally getting started requires very
little effort. From there, it only takes a few hours to uncover additional metrics like unit cost,
cost per customer, etc. Go [here][56] to review our entire setup process and the time commitment you
can expect at each step.

How much does CloudZero cost?

CloudZero uses a tiered pricing model that’s steady, predictable, and won’t vary month to month.
Unlike other cloud cost products, we don’t charge monthly overages — so, if your spend spikes one
month, your price stays the same.

## ¿Tenés dudas sobre Personal?

### ¿Tenés dudas sobre tu factura?

Podés acceder a la factura de tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o iniciando sesión en la web.
Solo tenés que ingresar a la sección “Mis facturas”. Si aún no tenés usuario, podés registrarte. El
registro es por única vez: el usuario y la contraseña que crees te van a servir para ingresar tanto
en la app como en la web de Mi Personal.

Una vez creado tu usuario, vas a poder consultar y descargar tus facturas desde tu computadora o
celular cuando lo necesites.

### ¿Qué beneficios tengo por tener más de un servicio de Personal?

Si tenés una línea móvil, junto a internet hogar y/o Flow bajo la misma titularidad, vas a poder
acceder a beneficios exclusivos, como descuento en la factura de tus servicios, descuentos en Tienda
Personal, WiFi Backup, Pack Mundo de regalo, y te duplicamos los gigas de tu plan. Conocé todo sobre
los [beneficios de Personal y Flow][57].

### ¿Cómo puedo gestionar mis servicios?

Gestioná tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o podes iniciar sesión en la web. Consultá el estado
de tus facturas, pagá, recargá crédito, descubrí los beneficios exclusivos que tenés y mucho más. Si
preferís medios de contacto tradicionales vas encontrar sucursales y teléfonos en la [página de
Contacto.][58]

### ¿Qué es Personal Pay?

Es la billetera virtual de Personal que te permite conectarte de una manera simple y segura con tu
plata. Con Personal Pay podés recargar crédito, pagar las facturas de tus servicios, aprovechar
descuentos y sumar muchos beneficios.

Descargá la app y descubrí todo sobre  [Personal Pay][59].

### ¿Fibertel ahora es Personal?

¡Exacto! Nos renovamos para ser más simples y brindarte la mejor **conexión adentro y afuera de tu
casa**. Ahora Personal te brinda el servicio de internet hogar, con la mejor velocidad. Si antes
Fibertel era tu proveedor de internet, no te preocupes, la unificación no implica ninguna tarea para
vos.

### ¿Qué es 5G y cómo funciona?

Es la nueva generación de conectividad móvil, que te permite navegar a más velocidad, con menor
latencia y una experiencia más fluida. Para usarla, necesitás tener un dispositivo compatible y
encontrarte dentro de la zona de cobertura. Conocé más sobre [cómo funciona el 5G y cómo
aprovecharlo][60].

## ¿Tenés dudas sobre Personal?

### ¿Tenés dudas sobre tu factura?

Podés acceder a la factura de tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o iniciando sesión en la web.
Solo tenés que ingresar a la sección “Mis facturas”. Si aún no tenés usuario, podés registrarte. El
registro es por única vez: el usuario y la contraseña que crees te van a servir para ingresar tanto
en la app como en la web de Mi Personal.

Una vez creado tu usuario, vas a poder consultar y descargar tus facturas desde tu computadora o
celular cuando lo necesites.

### ¿Qué beneficios tengo por tener más de un servicio de Personal?

Si tenés una línea móvil, junto a internet hogar y/o Flow bajo la misma titularidad, vas a poder
acceder a beneficios exclusivos, como descuento en la factura de tus servicios, descuentos en Tienda
Personal, WiFi Backup, Pack Mundo de regalo, y te duplicamos los gigas de tu plan. Conocé todo sobre
los [beneficios de Personal y Flow][57].

### ¿Cómo puedo gestionar mis servicios?

Gestioná tus servicios desde la app Mi Personal o podes iniciar sesión en la web. Consultá el estado
de tus facturas, pagá, recargá crédito, descubrí los beneficios exclusivos que tenés y mucho más. Si
preferís medios de contacto tradicionales vas encontrar sucursales y teléfonos en la [página de
Contacto.][58]

### ¿Qué es Personal Pay?

Es la billetera virtual de Personal que te permite conectarte de una manera simple y segura con tu
plata. Con Personal Pay podés recargar crédito, pagar las facturas de tus servicios, aprovechar
descuentos y sumar muchos beneficios.

Descargá la app y descubrí todo sobre  [Personal Pay][59].

### ¿Fibertel ahora es Personal?

¡Exacto! Nos renovamos para ser más simples y brindarte la mejor **conexión adentro y afuera de tu
casa**. Ahora Personal te brinda el servicio de internet hogar, con la mejor velocidad. Si antes
Fibertel era tu proveedor de internet, no te preocupes, la unificación no implica ninguna tarea para
vos.

### ¿Qué es 5G y cómo funciona?

Es la nueva generación de conectividad móvil, que te permite navegar a más velocidad, con menor
latencia y una experiencia más fluida. Para usarla, necesitás tener un dispositivo compatible y
encontrarte dentro de la zona de cobertura. Conocé más sobre [cómo funciona el 5G y cómo
aprovecharlo][60].

# Strategic intelligence and grounded context
# for marketing teamsstrategy teams
# and AI Agents.

Polaris7 maps the companies, technologies, and strategic movements shaping digital advertising,
marketing technology, and digital platforms. While raw AI search hallucinates names and misses
connections, our vertical knowledge graph provides the grounded entity resolution and context you
need to make decisions with confidence. Modern AI agents require precise, structured context to
perform research without hallucinating—which is exactly what our graph feeds them.

Polaris7 does not aim to list every company in the world. It focuses on the companies, capabilities
and relationships that matter inside complex digital ecosystems.

## Digital advertising, AdTech, MarTech, and digital platforms are too complex for current market
## intelligence tools.

The ecosystems behind digital platforms change constantly: vendors reposition, categories blur, and
critical signals are scattered across news, websites, and code. Traditional search and raw AI agents
cannot navigate this complexity without structure.

### Signal vs Noise

Raw AI search returns unstructured PR statements and SEO spam. Polaris7 structures actual strategic
shifts, partnerships, and product launches to isolate what matters.

### No Flat Databases

Generic databases only list records. Polaris7 maps parent-child structures, competitors, and
programmatic integrations to reveal the system architecture.

### Real-Time Updates

Static PDF reports are obsolete before they are printed. Our knowledge graph daily detects strategic
shifts as they unfold across the web.

### Grounded Graph

Standard LLM agents guess answers by querying raw, unsorted search results, leading to
hallucinations. Polaris7 agents operate on a validated knowledge graph, delivering facts you can
trust.

## Markets are systems, not lists.

Markets are not flat directories of companies. They are systems of roles, capabilities,
relationships, competition and strategic movement.

Polaris7 maps complex digital ecosystems—including digital advertising, marketing technology, and
digital platforms. By structuring these highly fragmented markets, Polaris7 helps teams understand
not just who the players are, but how they actually connect and compete.

The value is not in seeing more companies. The value is in understanding the right companies in the
right context.

[Get your encrypted email][174]

### Fundamentally different

Proton was started in 2014 by scientists who met at CERN and shared a vision of an internet that
defends freedom and puts people first.

Our transparency, open-source software, and rigorous encryption have earned Proton millions of users
— and the recommendation of the United Nations.

Tech companies like Google or Apple define privacy as “nobody can exploit your data, except for us.”
We believe nobody should exploit your data, period.

Our technology and business are based upon this fundamentally stronger definition of privacy, backed
also by Swiss privacy laws.

### Privacy for a better world

At Proton, we believe that a better world begins with privacy, and this is at the heart of
everything we do. Privacy isn’t just something we talk about; it’s a core belief and the reason
Proton was created in the first place.

We also believe in people before profits, and our primary shareholder is the nonprofit [Proton
Foundation][175], whose mission is to fight for an open internet that promotes freedom of speech and
freedom of information.

technical means to access your data without your permission.

ensured.

[Discover Proton’s encryption
][179]

### Swiss privacy

Proton is based in Switzerland, and your data does not go to the cloud. Instead, it stays under the
protection of some of the world’s strongest privacy laws.

We are a neutral and safe haven for your personal data, committed to defending your freedom.

[About Swiss privacy
][180]

### Switching made easy

Proton’s services are so simple and intuitive that anyone can use them. Move your emails, contacts,
and calendars from Google, Outlook, and other providers to Proton in just a few clicks.

Connect your Gmail to Proton Mail to read, send and receive your emails in one place, bringing you
one step closer to leaving behind Big Tech for good.

[Connect your Gmail account
][181]

### Open source and audited

Since we were founded by scientists, we know that trust is earned through transparency and peer
review.

All our apps are open source and independently audited by security experts so that anyone can
inspect them, use them, and trust them.

[Proton and open source
][182]

### One account, any device

Access your email, files, calendars, passwords, and VPN anywhere.

Get Proton apps on all your devices (Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux, and more) with
one Proton Account for all our privacy-by-default services.

[See all Proton services
][183]

Privacy is a human right, so our services are always available for free, and our encryption tech is
free as well.

account with more features.

#### Cut design time in half for faster, accurate designs that win.

[ Try it free ][63]
[ Learn More ][64]

**System Surveyor**

## AI NotetakerBeta

#### Turn site walk conversations into accurate & actionable project documentation

#### Your on-site companion for site walks that captures the discussion, automates a Statement of
#### Work, and preserves a trusted record of customer requirements.

[ Learn More ][65]

**System Surveyor**

#### Take System Surveyor with you for Installs

#### Now, everything you need in the hands of your installers, technicians and subcontractors for
#### more accurate, timely installs and lifecycle maintenance. No more print-outs, one single source
#### of truth.

[ Learn More ][66]

**System Surveyor**

## Camera Advisor™

#### Visualize & select the right camera every time

#### Using DORI standards, show the resolution and pixels per foot with images for easy camera
#### selection

[ Learn More ][67]

Drive sales and better customer engagement with an accurate, decision-ready design. Win more with
faster, more professional designs & proposals. **[Learn more][70].**

collaborate with partners and subcontractors. **[Learn more.][72]**

Easy, intelligent design for your products at the first site survey. Enable partners to automate a
bill of materials for your brand. **[Learn more.][74]**

## What Makes TryRDP Worth Choosing

Here is what you are actually getting when you buy an RDP plan from us, explained plainly without
the marketing fluff.

#### Actual Administrator Access

A lot of providers say admin access but give you a restricted account that fails the moment you try
to install something serious. On every TryRDP plan you get the Windows Administrator account. That
means you can install software, change registry keys, set firewall rules and configure the server
exactly as you need.

#### NVMe Storage Across the Board

We use NVMe drives on every plan, including the cheapest one. The difference compared to a standard
SSD or an old spinning hard drive is noticeable in day-to-day use. Windows boots faster,
applications open quicker and file operations do not cause lag in your session.

#### Protected Servers, Reliable Uptime

DDoS mitigation runs at the network level across all 12 locations, not just on selected plans. Our
datacenters are Tier III and IV certified with redundant power and cooling. In 2024 our average
uptime across all locations was 99.97%.

#### Pay How You Like, Refund If You Need

We accept credit cards, PayPal, Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT. Crypto orders go through automatically
without any ID check. If the server is not right for you, you have 72 hours to ask for a full refund
with no questions and no credit-only policies.

#### Support That Knows Windows

Our support team is made up of people who actually work with Windows Server and RDP setups, not a
general helpdesk reading from a script. Average first response is under two hours. You also get
Virtualizor access to reboot or rebuild your server yourself if you prefer.

## Common Reasons People Buy RDP

Most of our 50,000 customers fall into one of these categories. If your use case is not listed here,
feel free to ask us before you order.

[Forex and Crypto Trading]

### Forex and Crypto Trading

Running MT4 or MT5 on a home PC means downtime every time you restart or lose power. On an RDP the
terminal stays open around the clock. Our London and Singapore servers are popular with Forex
traders specifically because of the low latency to major broker infrastructure.

[Web Development and Testing]

### Web Development and Testing

Developers use RDP to test applications in a clean Windows environment that is completely separate
from their main machine. You get full admin rights so there is nothing stopping you installing any
runtime, framework or database you need.

[Automation and Long-Running Scripts]

### Automation and Long-Running Scripts

Tasks that need to run overnight or for days at a time are a natural fit for a remote server. You
can install Selenium, Puppeteer, Python or any other tool with no restrictions, and the job keeps
running whether your laptop is open or not.

[Remote Work and Business Tools]

### Remote Work and Business Tools

A lot of people use RDP to keep their business software in one place that they can reach from any
device. CRM systems, reporting tools, email clients and office applications all run cleanly on a
dedicated Windows server.

[Streaming and Video Encoding]

### Streaming and Video Encoding

Encoding video on your own machine takes up resources that slow everything else down. On an RDP you
get dedicated CPU and memory for the job. Our Germany plans go up to 16 cores, which is useful for
anyone doing serious encoding or live streaming work.

[SEO Tools and Digital Marketing]

### SEO Tools and Digital Marketing

Running rank trackers, scrapers and marketing tools all day on a laptop is not practical. An RDP
keeps them running in the background without slowing down your main computer, and you can check in
from anywhere.

About TryRDP

## We have been running RDP servers since 2018

TryRDP started in 2018 because the people who built it kept running into the same problem: providers
either locked down the admin access, oversold the hardware, or charged far too much for something
basic. We launched with two datacenter locations and grew from there based entirely on word of
mouth.

We own and operate our own hardware rather than reselling capacity from a larger provider. The
Windows installs on our servers are genuine Microsoft licensed copies. Our technical team holds MCSE
and CCNP certifications and the support staff actually know how to troubleshoot RDP issues rather
than just logging tickets.

## What Makes TryRDP Worth Choosing

Here is what you are actually getting when you buy an RDP plan from us, explained plainly without
the marketing fluff.

#### Actual Administrator Access

A lot of providers say admin access but give you a restricted account that fails the moment you try
to install something serious. On every TryRDP plan you get the Windows Administrator account. That
means you can install software, change registry keys, set firewall rules and configure the server
exactly as you need.

#### NVMe Storage Across the Board

We use NVMe drives on every plan, including the cheapest one. The difference compared to a standard
SSD or an old spinning hard drive is noticeable in day-to-day use. Windows boots faster,
applications open quicker and file operations do not cause lag in your session.

#### Protected Servers, Reliable Uptime

DDoS mitigation runs at the network level across all 12 locations, not just on selected plans. Our
datacenters are Tier III and IV certified with redundant power and cooling. In 2024 our average
uptime across all locations was 99.97%.

#### Pay How You Like, Refund If You Need

We accept credit cards, PayPal, Bitcoin, Ethereum and USDT. Crypto orders go through automatically
without any ID check. If the server is not right for you, you have 72 hours to ask for a full refund
with no questions and no credit-only policies.

#### Support That Knows Windows

Our support team is made up of people who actually work with Windows Server and RDP setups, not a
general helpdesk reading from a script. Average first response is under two hours. You also get
Virtualizor access to reboot or rebuild your server yourself if you prefer.

## Common Reasons People Buy RDP

Most of our 50,000 customers fall into one of these categories. If your use case is not listed here,
feel free to ask us before you order.

[Forex and Crypto Trading]

### Forex and Crypto Trading

Running MT4 or MT5 on a home PC means downtime every time you restart or lose power. On an RDP the
terminal stays open around the clock. Our London and Singapore servers are popular with Forex
traders specifically because of the low latency to major broker infrastructure.

[Web Development and Testing]

### Web Development and Testing

Developers use RDP to test applications in a clean Windows environment that is completely separate
from their main machine. You get full admin rights so there is nothing stopping you installing any
runtime, framework or database you need.

[Automation and Long-Running Scripts]

### Automation and Long-Running Scripts

Tasks that need to run overnight or for days at a time are a natural fit for a remote server. You
can install Selenium, Puppeteer, Python or any other tool with no restrictions, and the job keeps
running whether your laptop is open or not.

[Remote Work and Business Tools]

### Remote Work and Business Tools

A lot of people use RDP to keep their business software in one place that they can reach from any
device. CRM systems, reporting tools, email clients and office applications all run cleanly on a
dedicated Windows server.

[Streaming and Video Encoding]

### Streaming and Video Encoding

Encoding video on your own machine takes up resources that slow everything else down. On an RDP you
get dedicated CPU and memory for the job. Our Germany plans go up to 16 cores, which is useful for
anyone doing serious encoding or live streaming work.

[SEO Tools and Digital Marketing]

### SEO Tools and Digital Marketing

Running rank trackers, scrapers and marketing tools all day on a laptop is not practical. An RDP
keeps them running in the background without slowing down your main computer, and you can check in
from anywhere.

About TryRDP

## We have been running RDP servers since 2018

TryRDP started in 2018 because the people who built it kept running into the same problem: providers
either locked down the admin access, oversold the hardware, or charged far too much for something
basic. We launched with two datacenter locations and grew from there based entirely on word of
mouth.

We own and operate our own hardware rather than reselling capacity from a larger provider. The
Windows installs on our servers are genuine Microsoft licensed copies. Our technical team holds MCSE
and CCNP certifications and the support staff actually know how to troubleshoot RDP issues rather
than just logging tickets.
